picks.what: The ruined city seen from the citadel, postcard
picks.why: general view across the ruined city plateau from the citadel hill; Manuchihr mosque minaret at right; chosen over the city-walls postcard (#6) as the broader view

gaps: P0–P3: nothing usable (only inscriptions and colophons); P5: nothing usable (hits are other places)
notes: Kept the 2006 P6 photograph; the 2011 candidates (mosque close-up, north walls panorama) are not clearly better. #6 (city walls with the Greek-cross tower, same series) is a good alternative for P4.
